mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever felt, in this busy world that always pushes us to be more productive, that something’s still missing? Like, even after ticking off every task and chasing every target, there’s a deeper sense of meaning we’re all searching for? That’s the journey Stephen R. Covey invites us on in The 8th Habit: From Effectiveness to Greatness. Together, we’ll look beyond just being effective. We’ll explore what it really means to discover our unique voice—and maybe even help others find theirs too. Imagine a place where your daily work isn’t just about getting things done, but about finding real purpose, making an authentic impact, and feeling truly fulfilled. Covey’s wisdom lights up a new path, stretching from mastering ourselves to unlocking the potential in those around us. We’ll see how shifting from independence to genuine connection, and from competence to real significance, can change not just how we lead, but how we live. As we dive in, expect to uncover ways to bring your personal values in line with your organization’s vision, build deeper trust, and shape a culture where every voice matters—including yours. So, if you’re ready to move past the old definitions of success and embrace greatness as a way of life, not just a destination—let’s explore this together.
